name: Ankles and Feet, Seated
description: Four easy moves for ankles and feet that you can do at your chair.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Four easy seated moves for ankles and feet, on Movement Routine.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Do one move or all four.
howToPlay: Sit comfortably with both feet near the floor and read the move.
Press Start timer for timed moves, or count at your own pace.
Press Next for the following move, or Skip to leave one out.
tips: General ideas for a break, not advice. Keep each move small, and stop if anything feels uncomfortable.
